description: Guidance for configuring, operating, and auditing the Harvey local autonomous sales agent.

defaultPrompt: Help me set up Harvey from its official repository without inventing capabilities or skipping approval gates.
Review my Harvey prospecting plan and identify evidence, cost, privacy, and deliverability risks.
Troubleshoot Harvey using the error output and the repository's documented commands.
interface.longDescription: A repository-grounded workflow assistant for setting up Harvey, planning prospecting, reviewing signals and campaigns, preserving approval gates, and troubleshooting the local dashboard. It does not itself connect to or execute a Harvey installation.

name: harvey-sales-operator
